name: UN Comtrade (United Nations Trade Statistics)

export.label: Comtrade public REST API - data availability / goods flows
Comtrade Plus portal
Comtrade API developer portal (key registration)

import.label: Comtrade public REST API - import flows (flowCode=M)

api_notes: Public tier free, no key for /public/v1 metadata; data pulls need free API key (100 calls/hr, 250/day). Premium subscription for bulk. bulk.comtrade.un.org is DEAD - use comtradeapi.un.org/bulk. Licence: UN open data.

name: UNCTAD (UNCTADstat Data Centre)
agency_name: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development

export.label: UNCTADstat bulk-file metadata API
Goods and services trade data viewer

api_notes: Free, no key. JSON metadata API + CSV/SDMX bulk files per dataset. Rate limits undocumented. Licence: CC BY 3.0 IGO.

name: UN Statistics Division

export.label: UNSD international trade statistics tables

commerce.label: UNdata national accounts / SYB CSV downloads

api_notes: UNdata offers CSV/PDF downloads of the Statistical Yearbook; SDMX API exists for SDG series only. Free, no key. Licence: UN open data.

name: WTO Stats
agency_name: World Trade Organization - Economic Research and Statistics Division

export.label: WTO Timeseries API (merchandise exports)
WTO Stats portal

commerce.label: WTO statistics hub incl. trade in commercial services

api_notes: Free API key via apiportal.wto.org (Azure APIM). Timeseries API returns JSON/CSV; ~500 req/min soft limit. Bulk CSV also downloadable. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: World Bank WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution)

export.label: WITS SDMX 2.1 REST dataflows (TRADESTATS-TRADE)
WITS API documentation

api_notes: Free, no key for SDMX endpoints (note: trailing slash required or 307). Registration needed for custom bulk extraction in UI. Data sourced from Comtrade/TRAINS. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: World Bank Open Data
agency_name: World Bank Group Development Data Group

export.label: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
World Bank Indicators API v2 documentation

import.label: Imports of goods and services (current US$)

api_notes: Indicators API at api.worldbank.org/v2 is free, no key, JSON/XML, ~unlimited but throttled per IP; my sandbox got 502 from api.worldbank.org so the documented endpoint is cited via the help desk instead. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: IMF Direction of Trade Statistics (DOTS)

export.label: IMF SDMX 2.1 REST dataflow catalogue (incl. DOT)
IMF Data Explorer - DOTS dataset

api_notes: NEW endpoint: api.imf.org/external/sdmx/2.1 (legacy dataservices.imf.org JSON RESTful API retired 2025). Free, no key, SDMX-ML. Bulk CSV per dataset from data.imf.org. Licence: IMF terms, attribution required.

name: IMF Balance of Payments (BOP/BPM6)

export.label: BOP dataset - goods and services credits

import.label: BOP dataset - goods and services debits

api_notes: Same SDMX 2.1 gateway as DOTS. Free, no key. BPM6 presentation; annual + quarterly. Bulk CSV/XLSX download per dataset.

name: OECD Data Explorer / OECD.Stat
agency_name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development

export.label: OECD SDMX REST - Trade and Balance of Payments dataflows
OECD Data Explorer UI

import.label: OECD SDMX data query - BOP goods/services

api_notes: sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest is free, no key, SDMX-ML 2.1 and SDMX-JSON. data.oecd.org now 301s to oecd.org/en/data.html. Rate limit ~20 req/min per IP. Licence: OECD terms, most series free.

name: OECD-WTO Trade in Value Added (TiVA)
agency_name: OECD Directorate for Science, Technology and Innovation / WTO

export.label: OECD SDMX dataflows (TiVA DSD discoverable here)
OECD Data Explorer - TiVA indicators

import.label: TiVA foreign value added in imports

api_notes: TiVA distributed through the same OECD SDMX gateway; free, no key. 2023 edition covers 76 economies 1995-2020, 45 industries. Bulk CSV available from the Data Explorer.

name: ITC Trade Map

export.label: Trade Map - bilateral export statistics

commerce.label: ITC Market Access Map (tariffs/NTMs affecting commerce)

api_notes: Free registration required (institutional email). No documented public REST API; XLS/CSV export capped for free accounts. Covers 220 countries, HS 6-digit, monthly/quarterly/annual. Commercial licence for bulk/API access.

name: ITC Market Access Map (MacMap)

export.label: Applied tariffs faced by exporters

import.label: Import tariffs, quotas, rules of origin

api_notes: Free with registration. No open API; bulk tariff data available to ITC partners. Underlying TRAINS/WTO IDB data also reachable via WITS SDMX.

name: FAO FAOSTAT (agricultural trade)
agency_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

export.label: FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products trade (TCL)
FAOSTAT bulk download server (zipped CSV)

commerce.label: Agricultural value of production and trade indices

api_notes: faostatservices.fao.org/api/v1 returned 401 to my anonymous client - the REST API now appears to require a key/allowlist. Bulk CSV at bulks-faostat.fao.org is open and is the reliable ingestion path. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: UNIDO Statistics (INDSTAT / IDSB)

export.label: UNIDO Data Browser - IDSB industrial demand-supply balance (exports)

import.label: UNIDO IDSB - manufactured imports by ISIC

api_notes: Free browser access; full INDSTAT/IDSB microdata sold by subscription. No public REST API. IDSB gives manufactured-goods exports/imports mapped to ISIC Rev.3/4.

name: World Customs Organization
api_notes: UNVERIFIED - every fetch to wcoomd.org failed at TCP/TLS level from this environment (TypeError: fetch failed), so no URL could be confirmed live. WCO publishes the HS nomenclature and an annual illicit-trade report but no open trade-value dataset or API. Recommend manual re-check of wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature.

name: ILOSTAT (services and trade-related employment)
agency_name: International Labour Organization - Department of Statistics
api_notes: ilostat.ilo.org HTML returns 403 to automated clients (bot filter) but the machine endpoint rplumber.ilo.org/__docs__/ is open and documented (OpenAPI). Free, no key. Bulk CSV at ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk (403 to bots, works in browser). Employment by economic activity covers services/commerce. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: CEPII BACI (reconciled bilateral trade)
agency_name: Centre d'Etudes Prospectives et d'Informations Internationales

export.label: BACI dataset - reconciled bilateral exports, HS 6-digit

api_notes: Free bulk CSV after free registration. Derived from UN Comtrade with mirror-flow reconciliation (removes double counting, harmonises CIF/FOB). ~200 countries, 5000 products, 1995-present. No REST API - bulk zip only. Licence: free for research, citation required.

name: Observatory of Economic Complexity (OEC)

export.label: OEC REST API documentation (trade flows)
OEC explorer

import.label: OEC API - import flows by HS/SITC

commerce.label: OEC subnational and services trade views

api_notes: Freemium: anonymous/basic tier rate-limited; paid Pro tier for bulk and subnational. JSON REST + tesseract OLAP endpoints. Covers 5000+ products, 5000+ subnational regions. Licence: CC BY-SA for free tier.

name: Harvard Growth Lab Atlas of Economic Complexity

export.label: Atlas bulk data downloads + GraphQL API access
Atlas explorer

commerce.label: ECI / product complexity and services trade

api_notes: Free GraphQL API (docs at github.com/harvard-growth-lab/api-docs/blob/main/atlas.md) plus free bulk CSV/DTA via Harvard Dataverse. Cleaned/reconciled Comtrade, 1962-present, HS and SITC. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: Eurostat COMEXT (EU international trade in goods)

export.label: Eurostat JSON-stat API - intra/extra-EU trade by product group
Eurostat SDMX 2.1 dataflow

commerce.label: Eurostat full database incl. trade in services (BOP)

api_notes: Fully open, NO key. JSON-stat 2.0 + SDMX 2.1 + bulk TSV/SDMX files. Limit 50 categories/dimension and ~1M cells per query. Monthly CN8-level detail via COMEXT bulk. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (Eurostat re-use policy).

name: International Energy Agency (energy trade)
api_notes: UNVERIFIED - iea.org returns HTTP 403 to all automated clients (Cloudflare bot protection); loads normally in a browser. IEA energy-balance and oil/gas trade data are licensed (paid) for bulk; free interactive browsing only. Recommend a browser-based or authenticated check of iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-sets.

name: OPEC (crude oil and product trade)
agency_name: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries

export.label: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin - crude and product exports

import.label: ASB - crude and product imports by destination

api_notes: Free. ASB published annually with downloadable XLSX/interactive tables; no REST API. Note opec.org/data-download.html and /data-graphs.html now 302 to the 404 page after the 2025 site redesign - only the ASB page resolves. Licence: free with attribution.

name: IRENA (renewable energy trade and capacity)
api_notes: UNVERIFIED - irena.org returns 403 to automated clients and pxweb.irena.org failed TLS/DNS from this environment. IRENASTAT normally exposes a PxWeb API (px-web JSON-stat) which would be the ingestion path once reachable. Recommend browser re-check of pxweb.irena.org/pxweb/en/IRENASTAT.

name: UN Tourism (formerly UNWTO) tourism statistics
api_notes: REBRANDED: unwto.org now 301s to untourism.int, which returns 403 to automated clients. Tourism Statistics Database (inbound/outbound tourism receipts and expenditure = travel services trade) is subscription-based; free summary tables only. Could not verify a live fetchable URL - flagged for manual check.

name: US Census Bureau International Trade (USMCA/NAFTA reference)
agency_name: United States Census Bureau - Foreign Trade Division

export.label: Census International Trade API - HS exports timeseries
USA Trade Online

commerce.label: ITA trade data and services exports visualisations

api_notes: Census API free; key optional under 500 calls/day, free key for more. JSON. Monthly HS-10 detail. USITC DataWeb free with registration and has its own REST API. Licence: US public domain.

name: Bank for International Settlements
agency_name: Bank for International Settlements - Monetary and Economic Department

commerce.label: BIS SDMX 2.1 REST API - full dataflow catalogue
BIS locational banking statistics (cross-border financial services)

api_notes: MIGRATED: stats.bis.org web UI now 301s to data.bis.org, but the SDMX API lives at stats.bis.org/api/v2/ (SDMX-JSON 2.0 + SDMX-ML). Free, no key. Covers exchange rates, effective FX, credit, banking - relevant to trade finance not merchandise trade. Licence: free with attribution.

name: European Union (Eurostat statistical system)
agency_name: Eurostat - Statistical Office of the European Union

export.label: Eurostat SDMX 2.1 dataflow registry
Eurostat JSON-stat data API

commerce.label: Eurostat database - BOP trade in services, national accounts

api_notes: Same open API stack as COMEXT entry. No key, no registration. Bulk download facility publishes gzipped TSV for every dataset nightly. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States)

export.label: ECOWAS Trade Information System (ECOTIS)

import.label: ECOTIS - import tariffs and trade flows

api_notes: WARNING: the former statistics portal ecostat.ecowas.int is DEAD (NXDOMAIN). ECOTIS is live and covers the ETLS scheme, CET tariffs and trade info. No public API; HTML/PDF only. Free.

name: African Union / AfCFTA Secretariat

export.label: AfCFTA Secretariat portal - tariff schedules and trade data

api_notes: Note: afcfta.au.int does NOT resolve (NXDOMAIN); the live Secretariat site is au-afcfta.org. HTML/PDF only, no API. AfCFTA e-tariff book access is registration-gated. Free.

name: African Development Bank (Africa Information Highway)
agency_name: African Development Bank Group - Statistics Department

export.label: AfDB Africa Information Highway data portal

api_notes: Africa Information Highway runs on Knoema; free browsing, CSV/XLSX export, and a Knoema REST/atlas API (key needed for high volume). Country-level portals link off the main dataportal. Licence: free with attribution.

name: UNECA (Economic Commission for Africa)
agency_name: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa - African Centre for Statistics

export.label: ECAStats statistical data portal - trade indicators

import.label: ECAStats - merchandise imports by African economy

api_notes: Note the bare host ecastats.uneca.org serves only a meta-refresh; the canonical path is /data/ (http->https redirect loop if you request https://ecastats.uneca.org/data without trailing slash). Free, no key, no documented API. ECA also runs the ATPC trade policy database.

name: SADC (Southern African Development Community)

export.label: SADC Regional Statistical Programme - trade statistics

api_notes: Free. SADC publishes the Selected Economic and Social Indicators and a Regional Statistical Yearbook as PDF/XLSX. No API. Note /pillars/trade-goods and /pillars/trade-industry-finance-investment both 404 after the site rebuild.

name: EAC (East African Community)

export.label: EAC Trade portal - intra- and extra-EAC trade

import.label: EAC trade - CET and import flows

api_notes: Free. EAC Trade and Investment Report published annually as PDF. NOTE eac.int/statistics now 404s - use /trade. No API.

name: COMESA (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa)

export.label: COMSTAT Data Hub - COMESA export statistics

api_notes: COMSTAT runs on the Knoema/eGov platform: free browsing, CSV/XLSX export, embeddable widgets. NOTE the www. host (www.comstat.comesa.int) fails TLS - use the apex host comstat.comesa.int. Free.

name: ECCAS / CEEAC (Economic Community of Central African States)

export.label: CEEAC-ECCAS portal - regional integration and trade documents

api_notes: Very limited statistical output. No dedicated statistics portal or API found; economic data published as PDF communiques in French. Free.

name: UEMOA / WAEMU (West African Economic and Monetary Union)

export.label: UEMOA Commission portal - trade and integration statistics

api_notes: French-language only. Statistical output routed through BCEAO (edenpub.bceao.int) and the UEMOA multilateral surveillance reports (PDF). No API. Free.

name: ASEAN (ASEANstats)

export.label: ASEANstats annual international merchandise trade
ASEANstats Data Portal

commerce.label: ASEANstats - trade in services and FDI

api_notes: Free, no key. CSV/XLSX download per table; the portal exposes an internal JSON endpoint but no documented public API (my probe of /api/v1/datasets 404'd). Covers 10 AMS, intra/extra-ASEAN goods, services and FDI. Licence: free with attribution.

name: APEC (StatsAPEC)
agency_name: APEC Secretariat / APEC Policy Support Unit

export.label: StatsAPEC Key Indicators Database - merchandise exports

commerce.label: StatsAPEC - services trade and bilateral linkages

api_notes: NOTE apec.org/publications/key-indicators-database now 404s - the live portal is statistics.apec.org (StatsAPEC). Free, no key, CSV/XLSX export. Covers all 21 APEC economies. No REST API.

name: SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation)

export.label: SAARC Secretariat - SAFTA trade documents

api_notes: Minimal statistical function; SAARC does not run a data portal. Trade data for the region comes from member NSOs, SAWTEE and the ADB. HTML/PDF only, free.

name: GCC Statistical Centre (GCC-Stat)
agency_name: Statistical Centre for the Cooperation Council for the Arab Countries of the Gulf

export.label: GCC-Stat portal - foreign trade statistics

api_notes: Only the apex host verified live; the /en/ locale path and /en/statistic/statistics/foreign-trade both returned 403/404 to my client. Arabic-first site. Free, XLSX/PDF bulletins, no API.

name: Mercosur (Southern Common Market)

export.label: Mercosur portal - commercial policy and trade statistics

api_notes: NOTE mercosur.int apex 301s to www.mercosur.int - use the www host. Spanish/Portuguese. No statistical data portal or API; bloc trade data is best sourced from ALADI, CEPALSTAT or member NSOs (INDEC, IBGE). Free.

name: Andean Community (CAN)
agency_name: Secretaria General de la Comunidad Andina

export.label: CAN portal - Sistema Integrado de Estadisticas de Comercio Exterior entry point

api_notes: PARTIAL - only the CAN homepage verified. The legacy statistics host estadisticas.comunidadandina.org is DEAD (NXDOMAIN) and every /estadisticas, /temas/estadistica and /documentos-estadisticos path returns 404 after the 2024-25 site rebuild. CAN now publishes via Tableau Public dashboards. Recommend locating the current SIICE URL manually.

name: CARICOM (Caribbean Community)

export.label: CARICOM Statistics - merchandise trade databases

import.label: CARICOM Statistics - imports by member state

api_notes: Free, no key. Databases published as XLSX/PDF plus a Redatam/PxWeb-style browser. Covers 15 member states. No REST API.

name: SICA / SIECA (Central American Economic Integration)

export.label: SIECA statistics portal - Central American exports
SIECA - trade policy briefs and bulletins

api_notes: estadisticas.sieca.int returns 200 but serves a JS-only SPA (no server-rendered content), so scraping requires a headless browser or the underlying XHR endpoints. Free, Spanish. Covers CA-5 + Panama + Dominican Republic.

name: Pacific Community (SPC) - Pacific Data Hub
agency_name: Pacific Community - Statistics for Development Division

export.label: Pacific Data Hub .Stat SDMX 2.1 REST API
Pacific Data Hub .Stat Data Explorer

commerce.label: PDH .Stat - national accounts and tourism for PICTs

api_notes: EXCELLENT for ingestion: open .Stat Suite SDMX 2.1 REST (SDMX-ML and SDMX-JSON), no key, no rate limit published. Covers 22 Pacific Island Countries and Territories. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

name: UNESCAP (Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific)

export.label: ESCAP Data Portal - trade and SDG indicators

api_notes: Runs on Opendatasoft: free CSV/JSON/XLSX export and an Explore API per dataset (my probe of the generic /api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets path 404'd, so the API base differs - inspect a dataset page for its exact endpoint). No key for browsing. Licence: CC BY 3.0 IGO.

name: UNECE (Economic Commission for Europe)
agency_name: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe - Statistical Division

export.label: UNECE Statistical Database (PxWeb) - trade indicators

commerce.label: UNECE PxWeb - national accounts, transport, forest products

api_notes: PxWeb backend means a machine-readable px-web JSON API is available per table (POST query to /PXWeb/api/v1/en/...). Free, no key. WARNING: a site banner states economic statistics indicators have not been updated since 1 May 2026 due to database restructuring - check freshness before ingesting.

name: UNECLAC / CEPAL (CEPALSTAT)
agency_name: UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean

export.label: CEPALSTAT - LAC exports of goods by destination

commerce.label: CEPALSTAT - services trade and national accounts

api_notes: CEPALSTAT exposes a documented public REST API (statistics.cepal.org/portal/cepalstat/api - JSON/XML, no key) alongside the UI; CSV/XLSX export per indicator. 33 LAC countries. Licence: free with attribution.

name: UNESCWA (Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia)

export.label: ESCWA Data Portal - Arab region trade indicators

commerce.label: ESCWA SDG tracking tool and national accounts

api_notes: NOTE data.unescwa.org/portal 404s - use the site root. Free, no key. CSV/XLSX export; no documented REST API. 22 Arab states.

name: Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU)

export.label: EEC Statistics Department - mutual and external trade statistics

api_notes: Free. Publishes monthly/annual XLSX bulletins on mutual trade (intra-EAEU) and external trade for the 5 members. Russian-first with English mirror. No API.

name: Commonwealth Secretariat
agency_name: Commonwealth Secretariat - Trade, Oceans and Natural Resources Directorate

export.label: Commonwealth Secretariat - trade competitiveness and Commonwealth Trade Review

api_notes: NOTE thecommonwealth.org/our-work/trade now 404s after the site redesign - only the root verified. Analytical publications (Commonwealth Trade Review, Trade Hot Topics) rather than a primary dataset; no API. Free.

name: USMCA statistical portals (USITC DataWeb)

export.label: USITC DataWeb - US exports to USMCA partners
Census intltrade exports API

import.label: USITC DataWeb - US imports incl. USMCA preference claims

api_notes: DataWeb: free registration, has a documented REST API (dataweb.usitc.gov/api) returning JSON, plus bulk query saving. Census API free with optional key. Canada (StatCan WDS) and Mexico (INEGI DENUE/BIE) APIs cover the other two parties - StatCan WDS timed out from this sandbox so it is not cited here. US data is public domain.
